dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Notice
dialogues.text: "The stubborn weasel digs the dirt, its hurried form unseen; the key is given darkly, where the moving shadows screen.\nLet <color=#00E1FFFF>clanging Iron Coins fall and halt right at its feet</color>, a forceful claim may yet yield a bounty sweet."

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Notice
dialogues.text: (A line of tiny text is written in the corner of the notice, easy to miss if one isn't paying attention.)\n"The little ones have picky tastes, so use <color=#00E1FFFF>what they like</color> to tease out their trace."
